merge_requests.title: Implement payment tokenization service
merge_requests.description:
## Summary
Implements the payment tokenization service for PAY-101.

### Changes
- New `TokenizationService` class with PCI DSS v4.0 compliant token generation
- HSM integration via PKCS#11 interface using `svc-token-vault` service account
- Token storage schema in `mfs_payments_db` on `pghost-prod-01.mfs.internal`
- REST endpoints: POST /api/v2/tokens, GET /api/v2/tokens/{id}

### Infrastructure
- Deployed to pods: `mfs-pay-pod-01`, `mfs-pay-pod-02` in `mfs-prod` namespace
- Database migrations for `card_tokens` and `token_audit_log` tables
- Service account `svc-payment-api` used for API authentication

### Testing
- Unit tests: 94% coverage
- Integration tests with HSM simulator
- Test cases: TC-PAY-001, TC-PAY-002

Related: CHG0090101

merge_requests.title: Build idempotent payment retry handler
merge_requests.description:
## Summary
Implements idempotent payment retry handler with circuit breaker pattern for PAY-102.

### Changes
- `RetryHandler` class with configurable exponential backoff
- `CircuitBreaker` implementation (closed/open/half-open states)
- Idempotency key generation: SHA-256(transaction_id + merchant_id)
- Retry state persistence in `mfs_payments_db` `retry_ledger` table

### Infrastructure
- Service account `svc-payment-api` for payment gateway operations
- Circuit breaker metrics exported to Prometheus on `mfs-pay-pod-01`, `mfs-pay-pod-02`, `mfs-pay-pod-03`
- Configuration stored in OpenShift ConfigMap in `mfs-staging` namespace

### Configuration
- Max retries: 3
- Backoff base: 1s, max: 30s
- Circuit breaker threshold: 5 failures
- Half-open probe interval: 30s

Related: CHG0090102

merge_requests.title: Add multi-currency support
merge_requests.description:
## Summary
Adds multi-currency support to the payment gateway for PAY-103.

### Changes
- `CurrencyExchangeService` with real-time FX rate lookup
- `CurrencyConverter` with 0.01% accuracy guarantee
- Support for USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CAD, AUD, CHF
- Currency conversion audit trail in `mfs_audit_db`

### Infrastructure
- FX rate cache with 60s TTL in Redis on `mfs-pay-pod-01`
- Database schema updates: `currency_rates`, `conversion_audit` tables in `mfs_payments_db`
- Uses `svc-payment-api` service account
- Rate provider API integration with circuit breaker fallback to last known good rate

### Testing
- Test case: TC-PAY-004
- Edge cases: unsupported currency pairs, stale rate fallback, concurrent conversion requests

merge_requests.title: Encrypt cardholder data at rest
merge_requests.description:
## Summary
Implements AES-256-GCM encryption for cardholder data at rest for PAY-201.

### Changes
- `EncryptionService` with AES-256-GCM encryption/decryption
- HSM key retrieval via `svc-token-vault` service account
- Database migration: encrypted columns for `pan`, `cvv`, `expiry_date` in `cardholder_data` table
- Decryption audit logging to `mfs_audit_db`

### Infrastructure
- PostgreSQL `pgcrypto` extension enabled on `pghost-prod-01.mfs.internal`
- TDE configuration for `mfs_payments_db`
- Key material managed by HSM, accessed via `mfs-vault-pod-01`
- Deployed to `mfs-prod` OpenShift namespace

### PCI DSS Compliance
- Requirement 3.4: Render PAN unreadable anywhere it is stored
- Requirement 3.5: Protect keys used to secure cardholder data

Related: CHG0090201

merge_requests.title: Implement HSM key rotation
merge_requests.description:
## Summary
Implements automated HSM key rotation with zero-downtime for PAY-202.

### Changes
- `KeyRotationService` with dual-key support during rotation window
- `KeyRotationScheduler` CronJob (every 90 days)
- Batch re-encryption process for existing data
- Rotation audit trail in `mfs_audit_db`

### Infrastructure
- CronJob deployed to `mfs-prod` namespace targeting `mfs-vault-pod-01`
- Service account `svc-token-vault` for HSM operations
- Re-encryption batch uses connection pool to `pghost-prod-01.mfs.internal`
- Rolling key swap coordinated via distributed lock in Redis

### Zero-downtime Strategy
1. Generate new key in HSM
2. Enable dual-key read (old + new)
3. Background re-encryption of existing records
4. Disable old key read after 100% re-encryption
5. Archive old key metadata

merge_requests.title: Build settlement batch processor
merge_requests.description:
## Summary
Builds the settlement batch processor for PAY-301.

### Changes
- `SettlementBatchProcessor` with configurable batch size and parallelism
- `BatchAggregator` for grouping transactions by merchant, currency, and acquirer
- ISO 8583 settlement file generator
- Settlement state machine: PENDING -> AGGREGATING -> GENERATING -> SUBMITTED -> CONFIRMED

### Infrastructure
- Runs on `mfs-settle-pod-01` in `mfs-prod` namespace
- Service account `svc-settlement` for database and file system operations
- Settlement records written to `mfs_payments_db` on `pghost-prod-01.mfs.internal`
- Settlement files written to SFTP endpoint for acquiring banks

### Performance
- Target: 100K transactions per batch within 5-minute SLA
- Parallel aggregation with configurable thread pool
- Database batch inserts with 1000-record chunks

Related: CHG0090301

merge_requests.title: Real-time balance reconciliation
merge_requests.description:
## Summary
Implements real-time balance reconciliation for PAY-302.

### Changes
- `ReconciliationEngine` comparing gateway ledger vs. acquirer settlement records
- Real-time discrepancy detection with configurable threshold ($0.01 default)
- `ReconciliationReportGenerator` for daily and on-demand reports
- Grafana dashboard integration for reconciliation metrics

### Infrastructure
- Runs alongside settlement processor on `mfs-settle-pod-01`
- Reads from `mfs_payments_db` gateway_ledger and settlement_records tables
- Writes reconciliation results to `mfs_audit_db`
- Uses `svc-settlement` service account
- Notification via `svc-notification-svc` for discrepancy alerts

### Reconciliation Process
1. Listen for settlement batch completion events
2. Load gateway ledger entries for batch period
3. Match against settlement confirmation records
4. Flag discrepancies exceeding threshold
5. Generate reconciliation report
6. Send alerts for unresolved discrepancies
